auto_description: Keeps fetching on the server as bars close, until stopped.
auto_force_all_tf: Fetch all 4 timeframes every round (legacy mode)
auto_start_all: Start auto with the server list
auto_start_all_details: The server loops over its own symbol list (build ∪ database), 80 bars, every timeframe whose bar just closed. It keeps running after this tab closes and notifies Telegram each round.

match.countPlural=one: Loops over {count} symbol, {rows} bars, only timeframes whose bar just closed (cheapest). Runs on the server until stopped.
match.countPlural=*: Loops over {count} symbols, {rows} bars, only timeframes whose bar just closed (cheapest). Runs on the server until stopped.

match.countPlural=one: Loops over {count} symbol, {rows} bars, all 4 timeframes every round (more time and quota). Runs on the server until stopped.
match.countPlural=*: Loops over {count} symbols, {rows} bars, all 4 timeframes every round (more time and quota). Runs on the server until stopped.

auto_start_selected: Start auto with the selected symbols
confirm_cost: Warning: this calls paid AI/data providers and uses account quota.
custom_description: Fetches the chosen symbols and timeframes once.

match.countPlural=one: Fetches {count} symbol for {tfs}, {rows} bars, once on the server, then notifies Telegram.
match.countPlural=*: Fetches {count} symbols for {tfs}, {rows} bars, once on the server, then notifies Telegram.

dest_confirm_off: Reports will no longer be sent to {name} until it is turned back on.
dest_confirm_on: Reports will be sent to {name} again from the next run.
earning_scan_description: Reads the latest quarter and the next earnings date per ticker.

match.countPlural=one: Calls the earnings data providers (Finnhub, FMP, Alpha Vantage) for {count} symbol, possibly several times, then saves the result to history.
match.countPlural=*: Calls the earnings data providers (Finnhub, FMP, Alpha Vantage) for {count} symbols, possibly several times each, then saves the result to history.

err_ai_bad_response: The AI returned an unexpected answer
err_ai_http_error: The AI service refused the request (HTTP {status})
err_ai_invalid_model: That AI model name is not valid
err_ai_models_failed: Could not load the AI model list
err_ai_no_api_key: The server has no AI key configured
err_ai_unavailable: The AI service is not responding — try again
err_auth_password_short: The password needs at least {min} characters
err_auth_password_unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one
err_auth_registration_closed: Registration is closed on this server
err_auth_user_exists: A user already exists — registration is closed
err_drive_bad_id: That is not a Google Drive id
err_drive_not_configured: Google Drive is not configured on the server
err_drive_outside_root: That item is outside the allowed Drive folder
err_drive_root_delete: The root folder cannot be deleted
err_events_bad_headers: The message lacks its webhook headers.
err_events_bad_signature: The signature does not match this sender.
err_events_not_cloudevent: The message is not a CloudEvents 1.0 event.
err_events_stale: The message is too old (or the clocks differ).
err_gold_already_running: A gold analysis is already running
err_gold_price_failed: Could not read the gold price: {reason}
err_gold_unsupported_source: Unsupported price source — use one of {allowed}
err_history_not_found: That history record no longer exists
err_http_too_large: The request is too large (max {max} bytes)
err_jobs_server_list_empty: The server symbol list is empty
err_market_no_data: TradingView returned no data — check the symbol and exchange
err_radar_already_running: A radar round is already running
err_settings_offset_range: The offset must be between {min} and {max} minutes
fetch_description: Fetches bars for one symbol and shows them here (not saved).
gold_analyze_details: Fetches XAUUSD from {exchange} on every timeframe plus recent news and sends it to {model} (result shown here, not saved).
gold_job_description: Runs on the server, uploads to Drive and notifies Telegram.
gold_job_start_details: The server fetches XAUUSD from {exchange}, has {model} analyze it, uploads the result to Drive and notifies Telegram per your destinations.
gold_job_stop_details: Sends a stop signal to the running gold job; unfinished results are not uploaded.
history_cleanup_details: History rows older than {hours} hours will be deleted, always keeping the newest row per symbol and timeframe. This cannot be undone.
history_clear_details: Every fetch history row will be deleted, including the newest rows the exports use. Exports stay empty until data is fetched again. This cannot be undone.
history_maintenance_hint: Frees space by deleting stored fetch results.
inbound_intro: Results other systems reported here as signed events (CloudEvents over Standard Webhooks). Open a row to see the result where it was produced.
job_stop_auto_details: The auto loop stops after the current symbol and will not start a new round until started again.
job_stop_custom_details: The custom fetch is cancelled; symbols not fetched yet are skipped.
login_description: Use the account of this server.
msg_earning_no_provider: Every provider (Finnhub, FMP, Alpha Vantage) was tried — no earnings data for this symbol

match.deletedPlural=one: Deleted {deleted} row older than {hours} h (the newest per symbol is kept)
match.deletedPlural=*: Deleted {deleted} rows older than {hours} h (the newest per symbol is kept)

msg_radar_asof_ahead: This round's as-of ({asof} ET) is {hours} h ahead of now — the CSV files carry no time header, so the formula estimates it from the newest bar end (a 1W bar end can be up to 7 days ahead). Do not read it as real time.
msg_radar_data_old_days: The data in this round is {age} days older than when it was computed — it shows the market at {asof} ET, not now (fetch fresh data before deciding today)
msg_radar_data_old_hours: The data in this round is {age} h older than when it was computed — it shows the market at {asof} ET, not now (fetch fresh data before deciding today)

match.countPlural=one: Done · at most {keep} rounds are kept, so the oldest one was deleted ({stamps})
match.countPlural=*: Done · at most {keep} rounds are kept, so the {count} oldest were deleted ({stamps})

msg_radar_formula_csv: Building the formula file + news (formula csv)
msg_radar_missing_1d_nodata: No 1D → no full UIPT stage (falls back to the short UIPT-S mode) · breadth/RS computed from 4H instead (no data in the DB)
msg_radar_missing_1d_unselected: No 1D → no full UIPT stage (falls back to the short UIPT-S mode) · breadth/RS computed from 4H instead (not selected)
msg_radar_missing_1h_nodata: No 1H → no entry trigger layer (hourly VWAP/RVOL/OBV) · no stage can reach TRIGGER (no data in the DB)
msg_radar_missing_1h_unselected: No 1H → no entry trigger layer (hourly VWAP/RVOL/OBV) · no stage can reach TRIGGER (not selected)
msg_radar_missing_1w_nodata: No 1W → the weekly Kill-Switch cannot be checked · every stage is less reliable (full UIPT needs 1W) (no data in the DB)
msg_radar_missing_1w_unselected: No 1W → the weekly Kill-Switch cannot be checked · every stage is less reliable (full UIPT needs 1W) (not selected)
msg_radar_missing_4h_nodata: No 4H → the middle confirmation layer is missing (structure between 1D and 1H) (no data in the DB)
msg_radar_missing_4h_unselected: No 4H → the middle confirmation layer is missing (structure between 1D and 1H) (not selected)
msg_radar_reused: Data unchanged since the last round — the existing round is used
msg_radar_saving: Saving the round to the database
msg_radar_short_without_4h: This round fell back to the short mode (UIPT-S), which uses 4H as its structure gate, but there is no 4H → every symbol comes out NO-DATA and kill% = 0 by construction, not because the market is good — this round cannot be used to decide; select 4H, or 1W+1D as well
msg_radar_tf_mixed: {tf} has several save times ({count} values) — some symbols are left over from an older round
msg_radar_tf_older: {tf} is {hours} h older than the newest timeframe in this round — different clocks; be careful reading confluence across timeframes
msg_radar_thread_failed: Could not start the background worker
msg_tv_anonymous: No token or login — anonymous mode hits rate limits more easily
msg_tv_cooldown_active: The circuit breaker pauses requests for {seconds} s more (a limit was hit recently) — the test skips the pause
msg_tv_cooldown_none: No cooldown pending — no limit was hit recently
msg_tv_login_failed_anonymous: Login as TV_USERNAME ({username}) failed and there is no backup token — anonymous mode
msg_tv_login_failed_token_used: Login as TV_USERNAME ({username}) failed — falling back to TV_AUTH_TOKEN (check the user/password)
msg_tv_login_ok: Logged in as TV_USERNAME ({username}) — token valid for {minutes} more min (renewed automatically)
msg_tv_probe_empty: {target} returned nothing in {seconds} s — rate-limited or the connection was cut

match.barsPlural=one: {target}: {bars} bar in {seconds} s — unusually slow, possibly soft-throttled
match.barsPlural=*: {target}: {bars} bars in {seconds} s — unusually slow, possibly soft-throttled

msg_tv_probe_timeout: {target} hung for over {seconds} s — looks throttled or rate-limited
msg_tv_token_expired: TV_AUTH_TOKEN expired {minutes} min ago — paste a new token or remove it
msg_tv_token_ok: Using TV_AUTH_TOKEN — valid for {minutes} more min
msg_tv_token_unreadable: Using TV_AUTH_TOKEN (its expiry could not be read)
msg_tv_verdict_down: Cannot connect / rate-limited — wait 5–15 min, close TradingView tabs in the browser, then test again
msg_tv_verdict_partial: Partly connected — rate-limited at times; rest before running a job
msg_tv_verdict_slow: Connected but slow — probably soft-throttled; rest 5–15 min before running a job
page_desc_dashboard: Start, watch and stop data fetching on the server.
page_desc_earning_scan: Earnings results per ticker, newest scan first.
page_desc_export: CSV and ZIP exports of the fetched bars.
page_desc_gold: Gold price, AI analysis and the server gold job.
page_desc_history: Every stored fetch result. Open one to see its bars.
page_desc_home: Symbols the server tracks and the state of this build.
page_desc_portfolio: Open positions and trade history per portfolio.
page_desc_radar_summary: Radar rounds computed on the server from the CSV data.
page_desc_settings: Server settings, TradingView login and your password.
page_desc_stock_radar: Formula scans per ticker, newest first.
page_desc_watchlist: Tickers grouped in lists. Add, rename or remove them here.
password_changed: Password changed — other sessions were signed out
password_hint: Changing it signs out every other session (other browsers and devices).
pf_add_description: Records a buy or sell; a new portfolio name creates the portfolio.
pf_remove_details: Every trade of {symbol} in the portfolio "{port}" will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
pf_rename_description: Gives the portfolio "{port}" a new name.
radar_delete_details: Round {stamp} (digest and all tables) will be deleted from the database for good. This cannot be undone.
radar_new_record: Force a new record (do not reuse a round with the same data)
radar_run_details: Computes a radar round on the server from the latest CSV data for {tfs}. If the data matches an earlier round, that round is reused.
radar_run_details_new: Computes a radar round on the server from the latest CSV data for {tfs} and always saves it as a new round.
radar_run_hint: Uses the latest CSV data on the server.
register_hint: This server has a single user: once created, registration closes.
scan_description: Pick tickers, formulas and timeframes, then start.

match.countPlural=one: Fetches {count} symbol × {tfs} (about {calls} requests) for {formulas}, then saves the result to history. May take several minutes.
match.countPlural=*: Fetches {count} symbols × {tfs} (about {calls} requests) for {formulas}, then saves the result to history. May take several minutes.

settings_auto_skip_hint: Auto runs skip a symbol whose stored data is newer than this.
settings_timezone_hint: Times on every page are shown in this zone.
settings_tv_hint: How the server signs in to TradingView.

match.countPlural=one: {count} ticker ({build} from the build · {extra} added from the database)
match.countPlural=*: {count} tickers ({build} from the build · {extra} added from the database)

tv_mode_confirm: The server switches to {mode} and clears its cached TradingView login.
tv_mode_hint: Changing the mode clears the server's cached login.
tv_test_description: Checks that the server can reach TradingView and read bars.
tz_invalid: The offset must be a whole number in range.
wl_add_description: Adds a ticker to a list; a new list name creates the list.
wl_remove_details: {symbol} will be removed from the list "{list}" only. Fetched price history is kept.
wl_rename_description: Gives the list "{list}" a new name.
